description: This file defines classes and objects related to information gain and impurity statistics used in decision tree splits within Spark's MLlib library.

classes.name: InformationGainStats
classes.description: Holds statistics related to information gain for a decision tree split, including impurity measures and predictions for left and right nodes.

classes.name: ImpurityStats
classes.description: Encapsulates impurity-related statistics for a split, including impurity calculators and validity status.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the statistics.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the object.

methods.name: leftImpurity
methods.description: Calculates impurity for the left child node.

methods.name: rightImpurity
methods.description: Calculates impurity for the right child node.
